name: Apollo 11 crewed lunar landing and return
description: An integrated Apollo spacecraft carried a crew to lunar orbit, landed two astronauts on the Moon, and returned the crew to Earth.

impact.note: A new ability exercised by one programme; lunar samples served one scientific profession, and only five further landings followed.

date.basis: The cited source dates this scoped episode.

events.statement: Apollo 11 astronauts Neil Armstrong and Edwin Aldrin landed the lunar module on the Moon; Michael Collins remained in the command module.
events.caveats: This record is a specific mission and its integrated transport capability, not an attribution of the mission to the three astronauts alone.

evidence.supports: NASA describes the crew roles, lunar landing and command module.

contributions.resource: Apollo 11 commander and lunar module crew member

evidence.supports: NASA names Armstrong as commander and lunar lander crew member.
NASA identifies Aldrin as lunar module pilot.

contributions.resource: Command module pilot in lunar orbit

evidence.supports: NASA identifies Collins as command module pilot.
NASA identifies the Apollo 11 NASA mission and its operations.

date.basis: The cited source dates this scoped episode.

events.statement: The Apollo 11 crew returned to Earth and splashed down in the Pacific.
events.caveats: Return is a distinct later mission event, not the first arrival on the Moon.

evidence.supports: NASA dates the return and describes the crew.

earliest_record.rationale: The scoped capability includes return to Earth, completed on 24 July 1969; the lunar landing is retained as a distinct event on 20 July.

caveats: The Soviet Luna 9 achieved an uncrewed soft landing earlier; prior Apollo missions and many people contributed to the program.

measures.subject: Armstrong and Aldrin on lunar surface
measures.conditions: NASA reports 21 hours 36 minutes on the Moon; 21.6 hours is an arithmetic conversion.

research.note: Independent reader checked the named reviewed facets against the cited documents; no global priority or unreported funding inferred.
